evidence.t: No official elk winter range within 500 m, so the top score here is 8 of 11.
Burn from 2015 (fire N60584, 4,417 ha), right here: grass and shrubs.
Cutblock harvested 2015 (11 years old), right here.
Habitat zone Interior Douglas fir (IDFdm1): open forest and grass, fall and winter elk range.
NW facing slope, 10 degrees: grass greens up and snow melts first.
Black bear: young cutblocks and burns grow berries in late summer and fall (Tip).

flags.t: Private land 190 m E: no shooting within 100 m (109 yd) of an occupied house or farm building (synopsis page 10, 99%).

seasonRows.notes: Bag 1; 6 point bulls: antlers must accompany the species licence (page footnote)
bow only; Bag 1; 6 point bulls: antlers must accompany the species licence (page footnote)
private land only, with the landowner's permission

plan: Drive: from City of Rossland, about 112 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 49.10548, -119.02594, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: 800 m E, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 47 m, about 21 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: elk, Sept, Oct (season rows). Glass the edge of the 2015 burn (right here: grass and shrubs) at first and last light; in September listen for bugling bulls. Keep the wind in your face (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 8-12, Region 8. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R4A-elk-walk-0002.popWhy: Popular (more hunters): MU 8-12: about 2,812 hunter days a year for elk (2020 to 2024 mean), 1.24 days per square km, top third of BC MUs; access: close to pavement, a town or a rec site. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good for 2
tags.why: Cover edge here (cutblock or burn): one hunter sits at a crossing or glasses, the other walks the edge slowly with the wind at their back toward the stander. Agree zones of fire, a meeting point and a time at the truck (Tip, lesson: Hunting with a partner). Pushes are on foot only (99%, synopsis page 11, item 25).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.8 km and about 47 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).
